newsitem.title: USA: Canada's Chretien arrives for talks with Clinton.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Chretien arrives for talks with Clinton.

text.p: Canadian Prime Minister Jean Chretien arrived on Monday on his first official visit to the United States during which he will hold wide-ranging talks with President Bill Clinton.

Chretien will have 70 minutes of talks with Clinton on Tuesday, the Canadian embassy said. The two leaders will discuss bilateral ties including a dispute over a U.S. law, opposed by Canada, that would punish some foreign firms that do business with communist-ruled Cuba.
Clinton and Chretien will also discuss cross-border environmental issues and enhancing the world's richest bilateral trade relationship, valued at one billion dollars a day, diplomats said.
